description: Traceability crosswalk mapping mathematical claims, underlying premises, proof locations, executable code, tests, and empirical evidence.

records.target: Population benefit sign sgn(Delta) under rich class C_beta
records.units: Population risk reduction Delta = R(f0) - R(fa) in [-1, 1]
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Fixed target distribution P_T in C_beta; fixed hypothesis pair (f0, fa); marginal over target inputs X ~ P_T

premises.statement: Richness of admissible target class C_beta = {P_T: |gamma| <= beta}
Nonzero disagreement mass d = P_T(f0(X) != fa(X)) > 0
Binary 0-1 loss or multiclass target supported only on model predictions on disagreement region

records.result: Strict action uniformly sound iff |M| > beta; in [-beta, beta] abstention is mandatory
records.permitted_conclusion: Exact strict-commitment frontier relative to declared class C_beta
records.excluded_conclusion: Does not prove empirical knowability on unlabeled finite batches without externally verified beta

records.target: Minimax non-identifiability of benefit sign from unlabeled evidence
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Two admissible distributions P_T^+, P_T^- with identical augmented-evidence law z but Delta(P_T^+) > 0 > Delta(P_T^-)

premises.statement: Fibre over observable law z contains opposite-sign distributions when |M| <= beta

records.data_contract: Witness pair construction with matched evidence law
records.result: Minimax directional error probability is at least 1/2 without external constraints
records.permitted_conclusion: Label-free abstention is an information-theoretic necessity, not an engineering shortfall
records.excluded_conclusion: Does not rule out identification under narrower, restricted distribution families

records.target: Cell-level decision risk under conformal interval coverage
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Joint distribution over training, calibration episodes, and test cell; marginal over calibration and test randomness

premises.statement: Marginal interval coverage Pr[Delta^cell in [delta_hat - epsilon, delta_hat + epsilon]] >= 1 - alpha_cell
Exchangeability of calibration and test cell residuals

records.data_contract: Score-fold excluded calibration residuals, exact rank k = ceil((N+1)*(1-alpha))
records.result: Unconditional wrong-direction probability Pr[ADAPT, Delta^cell <= 0] <= alpha_cell
records.permitted_conclusion: Coverage-to-action implication for the declared measured cell target
records.excluded_conclusion: Does not bound conditional false adaptation FA_c; does not imply population benefit coverage

records.data_contract: Empirical confusion matrix over evaluated cells
records.result: Theoretical bound FA_c <= alpha is withdrawn; reported as descriptive empirical metric only
records.permitted_conclusion: Descriptive accounting of harmful commitments among accepted updates
records.excluded_conclusion: Cannot be claimed as a mathematical theorem guarantee under standard split conformal inference

records.target: Population benefit Delta via compound cell-to-population bridge
records.units: True population risk difference Delta = R(f0) - R(fa) in [-1, 1]
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Joint distribution under episode law Q; conditional on realized frozen model pair and fresh IID evaluation sample E_e of size m

premises.statement: Cell residual coverage Pr[|delta_hat - B_e| <= epsilon] >= 1 - alpha_cell
Conditional IID evaluation sample of size m yielding Hoeffding concentration Pr[|B_e - Delta_e| <= b] >= 1 - delta_sampling
Hoeffding paired-accuracy radius b(m, delta_sampling) = min(2, sqrt(2 ln(2/delta_sampling)/m))

records.data_contract: delta_hat, epsilon >= 0, m >= 1, alpha_cell + delta_sampling <= alpha_population
records.result: Pr[Delta_e in [delta_hat - (epsilon + b), delta_hat + (epsilon + b)]] >= 1 - (alpha_cell + delta_sampling); verified in exact-truth simulation (N in {18,19,39,99}, m in {32,128,512,2048}) with 100% population coverage and zero directional errors
records.permitted_conclusion: Valid population coverage when cell coverage and fresh conditional IID evaluation hold
records.excluded_conclusion: Not established for historical transductive benchmark panels where evaluation samples were used in adaptation

records.target: Development-based operational surrogate for population residual budget beta
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Empirical evaluation on 6,885 benchmark cells across CIFAR-10-C and ImageNet-C

premises.statement: Source-domain development proxy approximates target deployment residual

records.result: Surrogate was 1.4x-50x too small; 24-73% of evaluation cells violated proxy bounds; route withdrawn
records.permitted_conclusion: Negative result demonstrating failure of development-proxy estimation; latent residuals unobserved; raw sweep artifact unavailable
records.excluded_conclusion: Not a measurement of latent theoretical-class violations; does not invalidate KGA which does not use beta

records.units: Accuracy shortfall (regret) and unconditional false adaptation rate FA_u over 2,160 rows
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: 5 source seeds across 432 CIFAR-10-C corruptions (2,160 evaluations); synchronized deterministic replay

premises.statement: Identical frozen baseline, adapted predictions, and 11D label-free feature vectors across all policies

records.result: KGA achieves FA_u = 0.000 vs 0.037 for uncalibrated regression, sacrificing 0.0012 regret for complete directional safety
records.permitted_conclusion: Empirical validation of risk containment beyond heuristic threshold gates
records.excluded_conclusion: Does not imply superiority on arbitrary uncalibrated distributions

records.target: Synchronized ImageNet-C baseline comparison across Tent, EATA, and SAR (Task 3)
records.units: Accuracy, regret, FA_u, FA_c, and decision coverage across 108 noise conditions
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: 36 noise conditions each for Tent, EATA, and SAR on ImageNet-C (N=108)

premises.statement: Protocol-synchronized evaluation using identical sample streams and feature vectors

records.result: Under SAR (44% harmful base rate), all 1D heuristic gates suffer FA_c = 1.000; KGA achieves FA_u = 0.000 and FA_c = 0.000 with 0.33 coverage
records.permitted_conclusion: Conformal 3-way abstention is necessary under severe distribution shift to prevent catastrophic false adaptation
records.excluded_conclusion: Does not eliminate regret relative to condition oracle

records.target: Historical ImageNet-C SAR hyperparameter confounder isolation (Task 4)
records.units: Historical mean accuracy and regret over 5 reported arms on ImageNet-C noise
records.probability_space_and_quantifiers: Historical 60 cells per arm; the raw cell records and reconciliation manifest are not resident in the current checkout

premises.statement: Matched 5-arm control isolating learning rate (4e-3 vs 2.5e-4), entropy margin, and BN statistics

records.result: The historical report stated that the 16x learning-rate arm degraded and that the reported reference arm had KGA accuracy 0.4086 versus 0.3953 Always Adapt and 0.3734 Always Freeze; current raw records are unavailable for re-authentication.
records.permitted_conclusion: Historical descriptive context only; do not use this matrix as current reproducible evidence or as the sole authority for Task 4.
records.excluded_conclusion: No current selective-routing or hyperparameter-causality claim is supported until the 60-cell records and manifest are recovered and independently re-run.
